mapper.select: SELECT cm.* FROM t_chat_message cm INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(id) AS max_id FROM t_chat_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) latest ON cm.id = latest.max_id ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0 AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, message_type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{isRead}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0)

INSERT INTO t_chat_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, message_type, is_read, create_time, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES
(#{msg.senderId}, #{msg.receiverId}, #{msg.content}, #{msg.messageType}, #{msg.isRead}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0)
